supporting_observations.claim: The periodic connections are attributed to C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe, an updater identified in the inventory as approved and expected to check updates.pixelforge-suite.com about every five minutes. The process started at 13:37:43 UTC and made proxy connections around five-minute intervals through 14:07:46 UTC.

The successful proxy CONNECT requests shown in the evidence are for updates.pixelforge-suite.com and have status 200; the 13:42:31 attempt returned status 407 (authentication required), rather than showing a successful connection to a different destination.
Endpoint network telemetry ties the updater process (PID 5684) to connections to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080, consistent with the proxy CONNECT records.
The updater created a temporary MSI-named file during this activity; the evidence does not show that file being executed.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records describe HTTPS CONNECT tunnels and byte counts, not the encrypted tunnel contents; the records therefore do not establish the downloaded content or its integrity (for example, T046-00101, T046-00157, T046-00219).
The provided records identify the updater by path and process image but do not provide its hash or signature-validation result (T046-00098, T046-00103).
The evidence shows creation of a temporary MSI-named file but does not establish whether an update was installed or what the file contained (T046-00100).
claims_not_established: The contents, authenticity, or integrity of any data exchanged inside the HTTPS tunnels are not established by the available proxy and connection records (T046-00101, T046-00157, T046-00219).
The evidence does not establish that the temporary MSI-named file was executed or that an update completed (T046-00100).
unrelated_findings: Separate review recommended: a network logon for sam.okafor to WS-SOKAFOR-01 identifies WS-LMARTINS-01 as the workstation, although inventory says remote administration is only performed from WS-SOKAFOR-01. This is outside the alerted updater activity and does not determine this disposition (T046-00023, T046-00024).

Separate review recommended: DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM on WS-LMARTINS-01; the inventory does not list Dropbox as an approved service. The records also show a DNS query for x7k9m2.akamaized.net by svchost.exe, but do not establish that DropboxUpdate.exe made that query or connected to that destination (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00121, T046-00124, T046-00126, T046-00127, T046-00128).
